name.en: Dorfiella knowltonii water fern (historically Hydropteris pinnata)
name.zh: Dorfiella knowltonii 羽叶水蕨（旧称 Hydropteris pinnata）

description.en: Original stylized-inspired static water-fern art, using Dorfiella knowltonii following Hermsen (2025); Hydropteris pinnata is the historical 1994 name. Round junction structures are an artistic interpretation of uncertain, possibly sporocarp-like appendages, not confirmed reproductive organs. Colors, pose and nominal dimensions are artistic.
description.zh: 原创风格化静态水蕨美术，名称遵循 Hermsen（2025）的 Dorfiella knowltonii；Hydropteris pinnata 为 1994 年旧称。根茎与叶轴连接处的圆形结构，是对性质未定、可能呈孢子果状的附属结构所作的艺术解释，并非已确认的生殖器官。色彩、姿态和标称尺寸均属艺术选择。

author: Leon Made This / s010s
origin: Identity root at ground plane on body/rhizome sagittal mounting centerline; footprint offsets retained in authored pose.

sources.notes: Pinnate aquatic fern with rhizomes, roots and sporocarps. Original inventory verification: search-result. This does not assert a new full source reading.

sources.title: The Role of Hydropteris pinnata gen. et sp. nov. in Reconstructing the Cladistics of Heterosporous Ferns
sources.notes: Original abstract describes pinnate fronds, branching rhizomes, roots and sporocarps at rhizome/frond junctions; pinnae may be subopposite to alternate.

sources.author: Elizabeth J. Hermsen
sources.location: pp. 149–150: introductory morphology, homonym discussion and synonymy

sources.notes: Uses Dorfiella knowltonii, treating Hydropteris pinnata as a taxonomic synonym and Hydropteris as an illegitimate homonym. Simple appendage interpretations remain disputed: floats, sporocarps or reduced fronds.

nominal_scale.kind: art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed stylized-inspired static teaching art. Color, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified fine anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的静态风格化启发教学美术；颜色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化细部属于艺术选择，并非严格科学复原。
